chapter: String bands, serenading and violin players
title: Chicken Banks, Professor Young and the freelance bass man
summary: Dawson identifies Chicken (Arthur) Banks as a casual mandolin and guitar player, mentions Professor Young on violin with Clem, and explains Pickaninny played only short bands.
